metadata.riskMatching: Canonical names match after Unicode normalization, lowercasing, comma removal and whitespace normalization. Only the exact source labels listed in riskLabelAliases receive an additional crosswalk. Numeric risk IDs are Agency Costs crosswalks, not imported AIID source fields.

riskLabelAliases.canonicalLabel: Compromise of privacy by leaking or correctly inferring sensitive information
riskLabelAliases.rationale: The AIID snapshot includes obtaining in the privacy subdomain label; the current shared MIT taxonomy label omits obtaining. Agency Costs explicitly maps this exact source label to canonical subdomain 2.1 for filtering. The source label is preserved unchanged. AIID did not supply this numeric risk ID in the imported field.

limitations: Voluntary incident reporting is not a representative sample or an operational exposure denominator.
Different source incident IDs are not assumed to be independent harmful events.
The source linked-report count measures documents associated with a source record, not additional incidents.
Source taxonomy labels may be missing or erroneous; matching a risk label does not establish a matching job, system or sector.
No MIT priority-study sector is inferred. The separate CSET source taxonomy uses ISIC and is excluded here.
No financial amount, failure probability, loss estimate, deployment recommendation or insurance outcome is inferred.
